sources.note: Main website. Describes Greenway as 30+ year ambulatory health IT company with solutions across clinical, financial, patient engagement, analytics, and specialty-specific categories. Does not use 'Prime Suite' name on main page — uses generic product category names instead.
About page. ~1,000 employees, 55,000+ providers, 10,000+ partner organizations. History traces to 1977 Medical Manager. Combined with Greenway Medical Technologies in 2013 via Vista Equity Partners.

Certifications and compliance page. Lists ONC certification, Real World Testing plans 2022-2026, costs/mandatory disclosures. Products listed generically (EHR, PM, RCM, etc.) without Prime Suite/Intergy names.

Prime Suite product page. Now redirects to generic EHR page describing 'Advanced EHR tailored to your specialty's unique needs' without using Prime Suite name. Suggests product branding is being phased out.
Patient portal product page. Describes VDT-compliant records access, secure messaging, appointment requests, lab results viewing, family member access, SMART-on-FHIR technology.
Patient Connect benefit overview. Online patient intake forms that auto-populate into EHR. Referenced for Prime Suite integration but page content focused on Intergy.
Press release about 2015 Edition Cures Update certification for both Prime Suite and Intergy plus Patient Portal. Highlights FHIR API, USCDI data extraction.
August 2021 press release announcing doubled investment in both Intergy and Prime Suite. Focus on simplified navigation, modern interfaces, industry integration, backend optimization.
Telehealth product page. Greenway Telehealth integrates with EHR for virtual visits.

AWS case study. Greenway migrated to AWS HealthLake (FHIR service), ingested 9.5 billion FHIR resources. Serves 42,500+ providers. Both Prime Suite and Intergy are source EHR systems. 638 clients migrated to cloud in <1 day.

Third-party EMR review site. Details Prime Suite as cloud-based ambulatory EHR with 4,000+ templates, billing/claims, scheduling, patient portal. User reviews note reliable billing, dated UI, steep learning curve, limited reporting.
EMRFinder review. 3/5 stars from 55 reviews. Details clinical, financial, administrative modules. Notes integration with diagnostic equipment/imaging. Single sign-on for EHR and PM. 30+ specialties.
EHR guide. Describes e-prescribing, speech-to-text, population health, MediaDent dental product. Lists Intergy as separate PM solution for multi-site practices.
Software Advice profile. Could not access full content (403). Listed as a source for pricing and feature comparison.
KLAS Research Prime Suite EHR listing. Ratings behind paywall. Indicates Prime Suite does not have sufficient live customers for Best in KLAS ranking.
Press release about Vista Equity Partners acquisition of Greenway Medical Technologies ($644M deal, 2013). Combined with Vitera Healthcare Solutions.
Microwize reseller page. Lists Prime Suite as EHR + Medical Billing + Scheduling + eRx. Minimal detail beyond product name.
LifePoint lab interface page. Describes Greenway Lab Interface for PrimeSuite and Intergy — bi-directional lab integration for ordering and receiving results.
